entities.summary: James Friedrich Ludolf Hobrecht was a Prussian director for urban planning. His development plan of 1862 for a million-sized Berlin was soon to be simply called the Hobrecht-Plan. His main focus was on modern sewer, systems for which he was well known in the late 19th century.
